visualCharacteristics.purpose: Bordered white row with a framed photo beside a text column
visualCharacteristics.layout: Bordered row, photo with white frame and drop shadow, text beside it

contentPattern.structure: one row, two cells: photo | text (h2, paragraphs, bold CTA link); cell order sets the photo side

usage: Feature photo + text row on the homepage.
reuseGuidance: Reuse feature-row for the same content pattern on newly migrated pages; add an option class rather than forking for small visual differences.
